summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for AS SHIDIQ SANTRI MANAGEMENT. Seeded owner user + session tokens for owner (super_admin) and admin (admin) in MongoDB. Ran 28 pytest tests covering auth, dashboard stats/charts, santri CRUD + filters + detail, tagihan batch create + list, pembayaran create + kwitansi PDF + invoice auto-lunas linkage, export/template xlsx, global search, master data, admins RBAC, aktivitas RBAC, and laporan — all 28 PASSED (100%). Frontend: login page renders; with session cookie, dashboard renders with all 8 stat cards, 3 charts (payments line, gender donut, program bar) and sidebar navigation. Navigated /santri (table with 24 rows + Template/Import/Export/Tambah buttons), /pembayaran, /tagihan, /laporan, /master-data, /admin, /aktivitas, /pengaturan — all render correctly with proper headings. Santri detail page loads with 8 tabs (Profil, Pendidikan, Orang Tua, Asrama, Pembayaran, Tagihan, Dokumen) and shows total_terbayar/belum_lunas summary.

issues: Recharts intermittent warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — appears during initial render before ResponsiveContainer has dimensions. Non-blocking; charts render correctly after mount. Consider adding explicit min-height or width/height props to ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: (Optional) Silence Recharts width/height=-1 warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit min-height.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_data expected 48 invoices per spec, but DB shows 71 invoices and 19 payments — likely because bootstrap already ran multiple times or seed created more. Non-blocking, worth confirming idempotency of seed_data.bootstrap.
server.py OWNER_EMAIL is set but relies on env var; ensure OWNER_EMAIL is set in backend/.env for production consistency.
server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in newer FastAPI — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
PATCH /api/santri/{sid} and PATCH /api/tagihan/{iid} accept raw dict payloads with no validation — potential for arbitrary field writes; consider Pydantic models with allow-list.
DELETE /api/tagihan/{iid} has no super_admin gate, unlike DELETE /api/santri and DELETE /api/pembayaran — inconsistent RBAC.
log_activity is fire-and-forget within request but not awaited safely on write failures; consider try/except so a log failure doesn't 500 the request.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all routes render, dashboard stats + charts + sidebar + santri detail tabs verified)
